description: Courses: new GET /api/courses (any logged-in user; optional teacher_id filter) returning every teacher's courses derived from the ACTIVE TimetableEntry rows grouped by (subject, class), and a new Courses page (/courses, nav entry 'Courses', search + teacher filter, one card per teacher). Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-003; reuses services/schedule_utils.py (slot_minutes) created in FEAT-001. Never use CourseOffering (stale) or Subject.is_lab (unreliable): a course is a lab if any of its entries is_double.
steps: Confirm backend/app/services/schedule_utils.py exists (from FEAT-001) and reuse slot_minutes/round_hours. If missing, create it exactly as FEAT-001 describes.

Re-read backend/app/schemas.py, then add CourseSlot{day_of_week:int, day_name:str, period_label:str (e.g. 'P3' or 'P3–P4'), start_time:str, end_time:str, periods:int, is_lab:bool, room:str}, CourseOut{subject_id:int, subject:str, subject_code:str, class_section_id:int, class_section:str, role_in_course:str ('LEAD' if the teacher is lead in any row else 'CO'), lead_teacher:str, co_teachers:list[str], periods_per_week:int, hours_per_week:float, lecture_periods:int, lab_periods:int, lab_blocks:int, is_lab:bool, schedule:list[CourseSlot]}, TeacherCourses{teacher_id:int, name:str, role:Role, total_courses:int, total_periods_per_week:int, total_hours_per_week:float, lecture_periods:int, lab_periods:int, courses:list[CourseOut]}, CoursesReport{teachers:list[TeacherCourses]}.

Create backend/app/routers/courses.py (prefix /api/courses, tags ['courses'], Depends(get_current_teacher); docstring documents that every logged-in user may read all teachers, with an optional ?teacher_id= filter). Load active entries with joinedload/selectinload for time_slot, subject, class_section, room, teacher, co_teacher. For each active teacher t: entries where teacher_id==t OR co_teacher_id==t; group by (subject_id, class_section_id); lab_periods = rows with is_double, lecture_periods = the rest, lab_blocks = distinct block_ids among them; merge the two rows of a block_id into one CourseSlot (periods=2, start_time of the earlier slot, end_time of the later, period_label 'P3–P4'); single rows become periods=1 slots; period ordinal label uses the sorted distinct period_index list across all TimeSlots (P1..P8, same as TimetableGrid). hours_per_week = round_hours(sum slot_minutes of the group's rows). Teachers sorted by name, courses by subject then class, schedule by (day, period). Teachers with no entries are still returned with an empty list. Do not mutate anything.
Re-read backend/app/main.py, import `courses` in the routers import list and `app.include_router(courses.router)`.
Restart the backend on 8010 and verify the endpoint with a script (see verification).
Re-read frontend/src/api.js and add api.courses(teacherId) -> GET /api/courses[?teacher_id=].

Create frontend/src/pages/Courses.jsx: PageHeader (badge 'Directory', title 'Courses', subtitle). Controls in a .card: search (matches teacher name, subject, class, subject code; case-insensitive) and a teacher

Re-read frontend/src/App.jsx: import Courses and add <Route path='/courses' element={<Courses />} /> (not hodOnly). Re-read frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx: add { to: '/courses', icon: 'subjects', label: 'Courses' } to liveNav directly after the Timetable item (visible to all roles).

Re-read frontend/src/pages/Help.jsx: add a TOPICS card (icon 'subjects', title 'Courses') and a FAQ ('Where can I see which courses each teacher takes?', tags course, subject, teacher) describing the Courses page, search and teacher filter, LAB tag, and that the data comes from the active timetable.

Re-read the end of frontend/src/styles.css and append a '/* ---- Courses ---- */' block: .courses-grid (display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(340px, 1fr)); gap:18px), .course-row, .course-chips/.course-chip (small pill-like chips using --color-pebble), .courses-toolbar, with @media (max-width:640px) { single column, stacked toolbar }.
Run `npm run build` in frontend and delete frontend/dist afterwards. Do the browser/proxy check.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/courses returns 14 teachers; for each teacher total_periods_per_week equals the number of active entries where they are teacher or co_teacher (compare against /api/timetable/view/teacher/{id}), and sum(course.periods_per_week) equals total_periods_per_week.

hours_per_week == round(periods*55/60, 2) for every course and teacher; lecture_periods+lab_periods == periods_per_week; lab courses have is_lab true with schedule items of periods=2 merged from block halves; a co-taught lab appears in both teachers' lists with correct role_in_course/co_teachers.
?teacher_id=4 returns only Dr. Spurgen; unauthenticated call returns 401.
The Courses page renders at /courses with working search and teacher filter, per-teacher totals, LAB tags; 'Courses' appears in the sidebar for HOD and teachers; Help has the new entry.
`npm run build` passes; no console errors; responsive at 390 px; Timetable and Help pages still load.
verification: Restart uvicorn on 8010; HOD login; GET http://127.0.0.1:8010/api/courses; script iterating all teachers comparing total_periods_per_week and per-course sums with the entry counts from /api/timetable/view/teacher/{id} (expect 0 mismatches), hours == periods*55/60
GET /api/courses?teacher_id=4 returns one teacher; request without a token returns 401
cd frontend; npm run build  (then delete frontend/dist)
Browser (or Edge headless / Vite proxy fetch http://localhost:5173/api/courses): /courses at 1280px and 390px, search 'Python', teacher filter, no console errors; /timetable and /help still load
findings: Backend: routers/courses.py (GET /api/courses, optional teacher_id, get_current_teacher) + schemas CourseSlot/CourseOut/TeacherCourses/CoursesReport, registered in main.py. Verified on 8010: 14 teachers, 0 mismatches vs /api/timetable/view/teacher/{id}, hours=periods*55/60, ?teacher_id=4 -> Dr. Spurgen only, no token -> 401, co-taught labs listed for both teachers. Frontend: api.courses, pages/Courses.jsx, /courses route, 'Courses' nav after Timetable (all roles), Help topic+FAQ, CSS block '/* ---- Courses ---- */'. npm run build OK, dist deleted. No browser screenshots; checked Vite serves /courses only. Backend 8010 restarted and running. Not committed.
